from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u019/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = max((v for v in counts if v != background), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    template = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                if grid[r][c] not in (background, marker)]
    if not template:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c, v in template); r1 = max(r for r, c, v in template)
    c0 = min(c for r, c, v in template); c1 = max(c for r, c, v in template)
    ar, ac = (r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    for r, c in markers:
        out[r][c] = background
        for tr, tc, color in template:
            rr, cc = r + tr - ar, c + tc - ac
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-44eef5cb.py'; path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'))
print('saved',path)
